articles.title: Daifuku (TSE:6383) Stock May Be 19% Undervalued As Cash Flow Grows
articles.summary: Daifuku has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years, yet the recent pullback raises a fresh question about what its current valuation really says about the cash it can generate. With the stock now trading around ¥4,940, the core issue is whether that price can be explained by the cash flows investors expect the business to produce.
